SHIVAM KEJRIWAL

 PROFILE SUMMARY 
  
 Bringing around 4 years and 7–8 months of hands-on software development experience, with specialized 
focus on secure system design, distributed backend architectures, and cloud-native microservices. 
 Serving as SDE 3 – Information Security at Innovaccer, leading design and development of security -
focused microservices, APIs, multi-tenant platforms for large-scale healthcare SaaS products. 
 Capability to engineer event-driven security platforms that sunk production vulnerabilities by combining 
automated remediation workflow, real-time threat-detection services, and virtual-patching pipelines. 
 Designed and applied IAM services, WAF o rchestration layers, and multi -cloud security governance 
systems that integrate with 50+ SaaS/cloud platforms and back > $200K in annual internal savings. 
 Recognized for building AI -driven developer -productivity tools (secure -coding assistant, RFP chatbot) , 
architecting safety systems for generative AI platforms, mentoring engineers on secure system 
architecture, and embedding security-by-design into the SDLC.

 Architected and deployed a centralized password-management microservice built with Python, FastAPI,

 Engineered an automated WAF rule -management and infrastructure pipeline for orchestrating

 Built a real-time configuration-drift detection and rollback service using AWS Lambda, Azure Functions,

automatically revert unauthorized updates within about 5 seconds for 1,000+ events, cutting MTTR. 
 Designed a virtual -patching orchestration pipeline that connects vulnerability scanners, security

remediation cycles. 
 Developed a multi-cloud security governance service that ingests around 250,000 security data objects 
per day from ~70 sources, normalizes them, and runs rule -based analytics to surface 500+ high/critical 
vulnerabilities monthly, contributing to about $80K in yearly operational savings.
